segments.name: Digital bank
segments.description: Global digital bank and flexible payments provider serving consumers and merchants with payment, financing, advertising and savings offerings across its AI-powered commerce network.
segments.evidence: We are a global digital bank and flexible payments provider building the next-generation AI-powered commerce network.

revenueModel.text: Merchants pay transaction and advertising fees when consumers transact on Klarna's network, while consumers pay interest, reminder and subscription fees for flexible payment and financing products.
revenueModel.evidence: Merchant revenue primarily refers to fees paid by our merchants, generated when consumers transact on our network and also includes interchange revenue and fees for settling disputes.

changes.text: In 2024 Klarna divested Klarna Checkout, its online checkout solution, to a consortium of investors.
changes.evidence: On October 1, 2024 , the Group completed the divestment of Klarna Checkout ("KCO"), its online checkout solution, to a consortium of investors.
